name: Medicine Ball Chest Pass
steps: Face a wall rated for medicine-ball throws and stand with your feet apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold a rebound medicine ball at your chest and drive both arms forward to pass it straight toward the wall.
Follow through with straight arms and palms turned slightly outward as the ball leaves your hands.
Catch the rebounding ball softly with bent elbows, pull it right back to your chest, and reset smoothly for the next throw.
tips: Generate crisp power through your chest, triceps, and core without arching your lower back.
Stand far enough from the wall to track the returning ball before catching it.
